name: cvsmith
description: Build defensible role-specific resumes from reusable candidate evidence, inspect the exact PDF, and track real application outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify defensible, targeted resumes.
interface.longDescription: Organize reusable candidate evidence, analyze a role, build and inspect the exact resume PDF, and track what was actually submitted.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use cvsmith to organize my evidence and build a defensible resume for this role.
